cannotDeleteLast: You cannot delete the last scene.

config.title: Scene Config
config.exitTransitionDesc: How the screen transitions out when leaving this scene.
config.customTransitionHint: This plays your closing animation, switches the scene while the screen is covered, then plays your opening animation. Timing comes from the transition itself (set it up under In-Game UI → Scene Transitions).
config.sceneConditionsDesc: This scene will only play if all conditions are met. If conditions fail, the scene will be skipped.
config.fallbackDesc: If conditions fail, jump to this scene instead:
config.skipToNext: Skip to next scene in sequence

flowMap.title: Story map
flowMap.empty: Add a scene and your story map will appear here.
flowMap.unreachableHint: No choice or jump anywhere in your story leads to this scene.
flowMap.unreachableSoftHint: Nothing on this map leads here — but a script might send the player here.
flowMap.deadEndHint: The player arrives here and the story has nowhere to go next.
flowMap.fallthroughHint: This scene has no ending or jump, so it quietly continues to "{{name}}". Did you mean that?
flowMap.dynamicHint: A script here can send the player somewhere the map cannot predict.
flowMap.legendFallthrough: Just continues to the next scene
flowMap.legendOpen: Double-click a scene to open it.
flowMap.followHint: Watch a number move through your story — and find endings no route can ever reach.
flowMap.flowIncomplete: Some routes (scripts, or a loop with no limit) can’t be worked out, so a few places were skipped rather than guessed at.
flowMap.legendFlow: The light shows {{name}} flowing on from a scene that changed it
flowMap.legendFlowChip: “+5” is what a scene does to it; “arrive with 5–20” is what the player could be carrying.
flowMap.legendFlowNote: A range means it depends on the player’s choices.
flowMap.coverageHint: Counted while you test-play. It is only saved on this computer, and never changes your story.
flowMap.coverageEmpty: — test-play your story to fill this in
flowMap.coverageResetHint: Start counting again from scratch. Your story is not changed.
flowMap.coverageResetConfirm: Forget everything you have play-tested so far? The story itself is not changed.
flowMap.neverPlayedHint: You have never reached this while test-playing. Play your story and it will turn green.
flowMap.playedHint: You have reached this while test-playing.
flowMap.legendUnplayed: You have never tested this route
flowMap.legendCoverageNote: Counted as you test-play. Saved on this computer only — it never changes your story.
